# key<TAB>status<TAB>decls<TAB>note.  The key is the first twelve hex digits of
# the sha256 of the normalized sentence, printed by scripts/sentence_census.py.
# Edit this file, never metadata/NON_MF_SENTENCE_CENSUS.tsv, which is its join
# with the extraction.  A sentence whose wording changes loses its key and
# reappears as unassigned; that is the intended behaviour, because a reworded
# sentence is a sentence whose assignment has to be re-checked.
# Sentences carrying a printed \leanverified or \leanstep badge, and sentences
# sitting under an anchor the proof ledger already grades, are assigned by the
# script and are deliberately absent here.
